items.description: Ship the original 28 x 31 maze in maze.py with a validator.
items.verify: Tests reject asymmetry, unreachable dots, dead ends, missing tunnel or house, an energizer count other than four, and fewer than 8 erasable wall tiles; the shipped layout passes.

items.description: Implement the pure engine: movement, buffered turn, wrap, dots, scoring, lives, restart, delayed-frame cap, level clear, speed table.
items.verify: Engine tests cover every rule in the brief and pass; a stalled frame never moves an actor more than one tile.

items.description: Implement ghost targets, junction rule, waves, house release, frightened chain, eyes as pure functions.
items.verify: Tests pin each ghost's target, every tie-break, no reverse, the wave schedule, reversal on mode change, house release, the 200/400/800/1600 chain, and seeded wandering that repeats.

items.description: Implement Bookmark and Eraser with one owner for each rule, and --classic.
items.verify: Tests cover bookmark override and expiry, can_erase accepting thin interior walls and rejecting border, house, door, tunnel and thick walls, one use per life, and inert keys under --classic.

items.description: Implement the paper-theme curses UI, input loop and cue mapping.
items.verify: Tests cover palette pairs equal to Snake's in 256 and 8 colors, ASCII only, bounds at 80x40 and 100x45, undersize freeze and recovery, the strings check_arcade needs, cue map, mute, --no-sound, and terminal restore on every exit path.

items.description: Verify the real curses process through a pseudo-terminal.
items.verify: Steering, Bookmark, Eraser, pause, restart, shrink and recover, mute, Q and SIGINT, with terminal modes restored and no surviving child group; transcript kept.

items.description: Append the Pac-Man entry to games.json and update scripts/check_arcade.py (42 x 90 pty, select by j presses).
items.verify: The menu launches every game including Pac-Man and returns.

items.description: Add Pac-Man sections to README.md and DESIGN.md, naming the 80 x 40 exception.
items.verify: Both files mention tink_pacman, --classic and the 80 x 40 minimum.

argv: from pathlib import Path as P; [(_ for _ in ()).throw(SystemExit(f'{f} missing {s}')) for f in ('README.md','DESIGN.md') for s in ('tink_pacman','--classic','80 x 40') if s not in P(f).read_text()]
